ABC 123 Intro to Everything
Fall Semester (a made-up syllabus for testing)
Meeting Times: Tue/Thu 11:00 AM - 12:30 PM
Office hours: Wednesdays, 1:00-2:00pm on Zoom

Grading
Participation      10%
Quizzes            20%
Homework           20%
Exam 1             15%
Exam 2             15%
Final Exam         20%
Total             100%

You only need 85% of the participation points to get full credit.
We'll drop your lowest quiz. Late work loses 10% per day.
Your final exam score will replace your lowest exam if it is higher.
Decimals will be rounded up at 0.5% (e.g., 89.5% = 90%).

Grading scale
A 92-100   A- 89-91   B+ 86-88   B 82-85   B- 79-81
C+ 76-78   C 72-75    C- 69-71   D 60-68   F below 60
